recession.basis: PD multiplier at downturn trough. ASSUMPTION pending cited elasticity (e.g. supervisory stress-test charge-off paths). Band spans mild to severe.
recession.name: Recession (unemployment up)

rate_shock.basis: Added annual funding cost (pp) charged against interest income over loan life. ASSUMPTION; band spans a 100-400bp move.
rate_shock.name: Funding-cost / rate shock

quality_drift.basis: Logit shift on incoming PD distribution. ASSUMPTION; band spans a modest to pronounced deterioration in pool quality.
quality_drift.name: Applicant-quality drift
